title: Peak Finder
text: 确定输入信号的每个值是局部最小值还是局部最大值，输入 1 路、输出 4 路、无直接馈通；按 {Threshold} 指定低于此阈值的峰值将被忽略；{Peak type(s)} 指定要识别的峰值类型 Maxima、{Index base} 指定索引基准 Zero、{Output peak indices} 启用峰值索引输出、{Output peak values} 启用峰值输出、{Maximum number of peaks to find} 指定要识别的最大峰值数量、{Ignore peaks within threshold of neighboring values} 指定忽略低于阈值的峰值、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 数据输入 column vector of at least three rows | matrix with at least three rows

ports.name: Cnt
ports.summary: 峰值数量 scalar | row vector

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: 峰值索引 column vector | matrix

ports.name: Pol
ports.summary: 峰值极性 column vector | matrix

params.name: Peak type(s)
params.values: 要识别的峰值类型 Maxima and Minima (default) | Maxima | Minima

params.name: Output peak indices
params.values: 启用峰值索引输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Output peak values
params.values: 启用峰值输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum number of peaks to find
params.values: 要识别的最大峰值数量 10 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 1

params.name: Ignore peaks within threshold of neighboring values
params.values: 忽略低于阈值的峰值 off (default) | on

params.name: Threshold
params.values: 低于此阈值的峰值将被忽略 0 (default) | positive real scalar | vector

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on
